lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity spots are organized in approximately 10 visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region. The spots demonstrate a high degree of spatial regularity, maintaining consistent inter-blob distance across the lateral midline.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal alignment of circular blobs, creating a structured grid-like matrix across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal carinae are visible on the dorsal-lateral flank, each characterized by a highlight on the dorsal edge and a sharp shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 12-15 distinct high-luminance spots, with a higher concentration localized at the anterobasal region of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two Echeneidae individuals positioned near the ventral margin of the pectoral fin and the lower flank.
